newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Japanese bank to raise venture capital for Israel.
newsitem.headline: Japanese bank to raise venture capital for Israel.

text.p: Long Term Credit Bank of Japan (LTCB) will help raise money among Japanese investors for Kardan Technology Ventures, a new Israeli venture capital fund, Kardan said.

LTCB is undertaking to raise $15-20 million from among Japanese high technology companies. The fund itself will be $50-75 million, with the remaining capital being raised abroad and from Israeli investors over the next 9-12 months. Kardan itself will invest $5 million.
Kardan Technology, a unit of Kardan Investments Ltd, said the agreement marked the first time that a major Japanese financial institution was helping to raise venture capital for Israel.
The new fund will invest in early- and late-stage high technology companies in Israel.
